bias.en: Rebound · above the 5- and 10-day, testing the 100-day
bias.zh: 反弹 · 站上 5 日和 10 日均线，测试 100 日均线

read.en: SpaceX rose 5.8% on Nov 9 to $142.07, trading between $135.37 and $143.18; there is no 200-day yet (104 sessions). It is above the falling 5-day ($135.4) and 10-day ($138.6) averages, and below the flat 100-day ($143.4) and falling 30-day ($149.6). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 14 and below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 14 ($149.47), and RSI is 48.
read.zh: SpaceX 11月9日上涨 5.8%，收于 $142.07，盘中区间 $135.37–143.18；上市仅 104 个交易日，尚无 200 日均线。股价位于下行的 5 日（$135.4）和 10 日均线（$138.6）上方，走平的 100 日均线（$143.4）和下行的 30 日均线（$149.6）下方。MACD 自 10月14日起位于信号线下方且在零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月14日起看空（$149.47），RSI 为 48。

read.en: The rally cleared the $134.3–135.3 and $139.1–141.3 resistances (5-day, 10-day, Nov 3 close), now support, and stopped under the 100-day. Resistance is $143.2–143.4 (Nov 9 high, 100-day), then $149.5–149.8 (SAR, 30-day, Aug 17 high) and $155 (Sep 8 high). Support is $138.6–141.3, then $134.5–135.4 and $130.2–131.9. A close above $143.4 would target $149.5–149.8; below $138.6, $135.
